name: acid-prophet
description: Spec-driven development for Codex with stable AC traceability: constitution → EARS spec with AC-### ids → audit gates → dependency-ordered plan and quickstart evidence → checklist → drift check. Optional Linear handoff.

interface.shortDescription: Turn raw ideas into reviewed specs
interface.longDescription: Acid Prophet is a spec-driven development pipeline for Codex. Ratify project articles into a constitution. Turn ideas into specs through one-question-at-a-time clarification and stable EARS Acceptance ids, with explicit [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers when uncertain. Audit specs against SDD structure, codebase reality, and Phase -1 gates including acceptance traceability. Expand ratified specs into dependency-ordered plans with typed contracts, quickstart evidence, and exhaustive AC coverage. Derive acceptance checklists for QA, detect drift by AC id, and hand off approved artifacts to Linear Devotee.
defaultPrompt: Use Acid Prophet to turn this feature idea into a reviewed spec.
Use Acid Prophet to structure this project before creating Linear work.
